description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single ranged attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Ice with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Ice Mode I: Laguna] and [Ice Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Dual Awoken Ice Mode I: Laguna
description.text: Ice abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Ice abilities trigger 2 additional times, critical chance =25%/50%/75%/100% after casting 1/2/3/4+ Ice abilities

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Grants [Instant ATB 1] and [Dual Awoken Ice Mode II: Laguna]

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Dual Awoken Ice Mode II: Laguna
description.text: Ice abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, instant cast speed for Ice abilities, causes [Imperil Ice 20% (15s)] after using Ice abilities, grants [Instant Cast 1] to the user after using Ice abilities

description.name: Attach Ice with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Ice Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Ice 3
